additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Ankita
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R1 170001391
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
bDx6Wi
Problem Description
: Broken CCV terminal
Site intervention will be necessary to resolve the error of "Terminal candidate list empty".
Kindly follow the troubleshooting steps:
Verify Ports
: Check that the correct ports are being used to connect the CORA10 to the OPM-C60.
Inspect Cable Connections
: Ensure the cable connection between the Processing Unit and the Card Reader is secure.
Reconnect Cables
: Reconnect all cables and restart the charger.
Replace CORA10
: If the issue persists, please consider exchanging the CORA10(payment terminal).
MLFB of CORA10:
8EM5903-0AA02-7AA1 -PZ2 Credit Card Reader CCV Contactless
If Support is required during site Intervention please do let us know.
For future reference, your case number is
0399598
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0399598-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R1 170001391] Broken CCV terminal CRM:01811000576
additional_info.body:
Hello Ankita
Thanks fort he reply, the terminal candidate list empty error is with the new terminal after we replaced the broken one. The old one won’t establish a connection for more then 2 seconds. Seems that the usb port of the terminal is broken. For the new terminal we receive the list empty error and we already contacted ccv for it. We just need permission to replace the broken old one under warranty since the new one will establish a stable connection.
Br.
